description: This file defines a web scraper function for 'thespruceeats.com' recipes, utilizing 'request' for HTTP requests and 'cheerio' for HTML parsing. It constructs a recipe object by extracting image, title, ingredients, instructions, tags, and timing information from the webpage.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema class for structuring recipe data, imported from a helper module.

methods.name: theSpruceEats
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, and extracts recipe details into a structured object.
